name: Retry the panel after losing connectivity
description: The installed panel requests the real Django session on launch. If a panel or Django login navigation fails at the network boundary, a localized offline page offers Retry at the original URL. Reconnection restores the online page; continued loss keeps the notice. The worker does not cache data or intercept API calls, writes, public pages or platform routes. Executed against the generated build through playwright.pwa.config.js.
